hints.title: Direct Meeting Condition
hints.text: If a <= b and heights[a] < heights[b], Alice can jump directly to Bob, making index b the answer.

hints.title: Offline Query Grouping
hints.text: For queries where heights[a] >= heights[b], group the query at index b requesting the first subsequent building taller than heights[a].

hints.title: Min-Heap Sweep
hints.text: Scan buildings from left to right with a min-heap storing pending queries ordered by required height.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating each query independently takes O(n * q) which times out for 50,000 queries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n + q) priority queue and pending query storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort or group queries to solve next greater element with a priority queue.
